description: This file contains unit tests for the CounterAggregatorGroup class in Orleans, testing its caching mechanism, collection of metrics, and thread safety.

classes.name: CounterAggregatorGroupTests
classes.description: Unit test class for CounterAggregatorGroup functionality, including caching, collection, and thread safety.

methods.name: ValidateAggregatorCache
methods.description: Tests that the CounterAggregatorGroup correctly caches and reuses aggregator instances for the same metric and tags.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Verifies the collection process retrieves correct aggregated metric values from multiple counters.

methods.name: TestMultithreadedCorrectness
methods.description: Ensures thread safety and correctness of metrics aggregation under high concurrency.
